note: Value-free admission rules for the public repository. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions; canaries use \u escapes so this file never matches its own rules. scope all: every file, path name, commit message and PR text; prose: .md, .txt and .rst files, commit messages and PR text; prose-and-code: those plus source files. allow_classes names content classes (classes.json) a rule skips, allow_paths names paths it skips. agent_notes_exempt: the rule skips a collapsed Agent notes section in commit messages and PR text. Rules whose pattern would itself name a private thing live in the private pack, never here. codes holds the fix text of every code check.ts can print; docs/public-safety.md has one section per code.

rules.description: Capy machine ids (shard provenance in raw receipts is allowed)
Ubicloud VM names (shard provenance in raw receipts is allowed)
The Capy drive mount path, in every file
A report section under the heading Spend (internal)
A line stating a program-wide spend total (run reports and preregistrations under docs/benchmarks/ state their own run's spend)
patterns: (?:[Ss]pend so far|[Ss]pend across every lane|[Pp]ublished total|[Pp]rogram spend to date|program-wide total)[^\n]*\$[0-9][0-9,]*\.[0-9]{2}

rules.description: A line outside docs/benchmarks/ stating an eval-level all-in or total figure
Inline comments that switch a secret scanner off for a line
Strings shaped like a model provider API key
Crew talk in prose: the crew's threads, its blocking reports and its drive by name
The crew lead named by title in prose: allowed as the name of a decider in run documents, decisions and the changelog

PS-CAPY-LINK.fix: Remove the session log link; cite the commit, file or receipt it pointed at instead.

PS-JAM-ID.fix: Remove the thread id; name the issue code or the commit instead.

PS-MACHINE-ID.fix: Remove the machine id, or keep it only in a raw receipt under a receipts path.

PS-VM-NAME.fix: Remove the VM name, or keep it only in a raw receipt under a receipts path.

PS-DRIVE-PATH.fix: Replace the drive mount path with a repository path or a sha256 pin of the file.

PS-SPEND-SECTION.fix: Move the internal spend section out of the public file; it belongs in the private ledger notes.

PS-SPEND-TOTAL.fix: Drop the program or eval spend total; cost per solved task and cost per trial may stay.

PS-SCANNER-SUPPRESSION.fix: Remove the inline comment that turns a secret scanner off; split a test literal instead.

PS-CREW-CHATTER.fix: Rewrite the sentence for an outside reader, or move it into the collapsed Agent notes section of the PR.

PS-CAPTAIN-MENTION.fix: Name the decision or the role in plain words; the crew lead's title is allowed only in run documents, decisions and the changelog.

PS-KEY-SHAPE.fix: Remove the key-shaped string. A test builds its canary at run time from parts; a real key is reported, not rotated by an agent.

PS-GITLEAKS.fix: Remove the credential-shaped string gitleaks found; for a proven false positive, add a blob-bound allow.json entry with --allow.

PS-IDENTITY.fix: Commit with a GitHub noreply address (<id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com) as author and committer, and use one in every message line of the form Key: value that carries an address (Co-authored-by, Signed-off-by and any other trailer), then rewrite the branch.

PS-SPEND-PATH.fix: Remove the spend ledger, proxy usage log or spend reconciliation file from every commit of the branch; it stays private.

PS-REF.fix: Push only branches under refs/heads/; tags and other namespaces are not accepted on the public repository.

PS-CLASS.fix: The path matches no class in scripts/public-safety/classes.json, or a deny rule there; move the file or add a class in a reviewed change.

PS-FORMAT.fix: The file is a format its content class does not allow, or a container is corrupt, unsupported or over budget; commit it as text or a supported container.

PS-SIZE.fix: The file is over its content class size budget in classes.json; split it, compress it as gzip, or keep it out of the repository.

PS-PRIVATE-VALUE.fix: Not allowlistable; see the private record.

PS-PRIVATE-PATTERN.fix: Not allowlistable; see the private record.

PS-PRIVATE-IDENTITY.fix: Not allowlistable; see the private record.

PS-PRIVATE-SHINGLE.fix: Not allowlistable; see the private record.

PS-USAGE.fix: Fix the named argument; the usage text lists every invocation.

PS-TOOL-DOWNLOAD.fix: The pinned gitleaks could not be downloaded; check the network and run the command again.

PS-TOOL-SHA.fix: The downloaded tool does not match tools.lock or reports another version; delete the tool cache and run again, and report it if it repeats.

PS-TOOL-TIMEOUT.fix: A tool or git call passed its deadline and its process group was killed; run again, and report it if it repeats.

PS-BASE.fix: The base commit is not in this repository; fetch the public main (git fetch origin main) and run again.

PS-PACK-MISSING.fix: The private pack or its pin file is missing; install them, then run check.ts --doctor.

PS-PACK-SHA.fix: The private pack does not match its pinned sha256; install the pinned pack, then run check.ts --doctor.

PS-PACK-INVALID.fix: The private pack does not follow schema harness-evals-admission-pack/1; rebuild it with the pack builder.

PS-GATE-TREE.fix: The gate tree the pack pins is missing or does not hash to its id; fetch the public main and run check.ts --doctor again.

PS-INTERNAL.fix: The gate failed inside; keep the trace file it names and report it.

PS-ID-CONFIG.fix: Set this checkout's user.email to your GitHub noreply address, then run check.ts --doctor again.

PS-HOOK-PATH.fix: core.hooksPath is set, so .git/hooks never runs; unset it, then run check.ts --doctor again.

PS-HOOK-CHAIN.fix: An existing pre-push hook does not run pre-push.local; make it run pre-push.local with the same arguments and stdin, then run check.ts --doctor again.

PS-CANARY.fix: The installed hook let a canary push through; run check.ts --doctor again and report it if it repeats.

PS-HOOK.fix: The pre-push hook refused the push (PS-HOOK-<exit>); read the findings above it. Pushing with --no-verify to a public remote is forbidden.

PS-HOOK-RECEIPT.fix: The pinned gate exited 0 without a receipt for every pushed ref; run check.ts --doctor again and report it if it repeats.
